description: This file contains performance test classes and methods for event-sourced counters grain in a project utilizing Orleans framework. It includes test methods for measuring throughput under different configurations, using xUnit for testing and custom test ordering.

classes.name: CountersGrainTests
classes.description: A class containing performance test methods for event-sourced counters grain, testing different configurations and synchronization strategies.

classes.name: RunThisFirstAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute used to mark test methods that should run before others in the test execution order.

classes.name: SimplePriorityOrderer
classes.description: An implementation of ITestCaseOrderer that orders test cases to run those marked with RunThisFirstAttribute first.

methods.name: Perf_Warmup
methods.description: Initializes and resets grains to prepare for performance testing.
